description: Timed transcripts of public videos: the platform's caption track, or speech-to-text on the audio when there is none. Pass url: its link or ID. Price per successful call: Facebook, Instagram, LinkedIn, Reddit, Rumble, TikTok, X, YouTube: 1 credit (captions) or 2 credits + 2 per started minute of media (speech-to-text, automatic up to 3 minutes, longer with transcribe_audio=true). Kick, Twitch: 2 credits + 2 per started minute of media (speech-to-text, automatic up to 3 minutes, longer with transcribe_audio=true).

cursor.description: next_cursor from this tool's previous result: the rest of a cut result. Send the same other arguments.

detail.description: concise (default) returns the fields that answer most questions, without segments and platform_specific; full returns every field. Same price: ask for full in the first call when you need one of them.

lang.description: Only on Kick, Reddit, Rumble, TikTok, Twitch, X or YouTube. Preferred language: a BCP-47 tag such as en or pt-BR (case-insensitive; _ is read as -).

max_age.description: Accept a cached answer up to this many seconds old; cache hits are free. Omit to always fetch live.

max_credits.description: The most this request may be charged, in credits. One that would cost more stops first, free, with insufficient_credits (details.reason max_credits). Omit for the endpoint's price, up to its maximum.

platform.description: Optional: a link names its platform. Needed only for a bare ID.

transcribe_audio.description: Speech-to-text for media without captions, at the speech-to-text price.

url.description: A link to the item (as shared: a mobile, short or share link works) or its ID.

name: get_transcript
title: Transcript by link
